description: This file defines the client interface and implementation for managing Kubernetes Service resources in version v1, including methods for create, update, delete, get, list, watch, patch, and apply operations.

classes.name: ServicesGetter
classes.description: Interface providing method to get ServiceInterface for a namespace.

classes.name: ServiceInterface
classes.description: Interface defining methods to manage Kubernetes Service resources.

classes.name: services
classes.description: Implementation of ServiceInterface, encapsulating client logic for Service resources.

methods.name: UpdateStatus
methods.description: Updates the status subresource of a Service.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a Service resource by name.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a Service resource by name.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists Service resources based on provided options.

methods.name: Watch
methods.description: Watches for changes to Service resources.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Applies a patch to a Service resource.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies a declarative configuration to a Service.

methods.name: ApplyStatus
methods.description: Applies a declarative configuration to the status of a Service.

methods.name: newServices
methods.description: Constructs a new services client for a given namespace.
